propPlay.writeup:
Napheesa Collier has cleared 13+ points in 92% of her 12 games this season. She's hitting 90% over her last 10 and 80% over her last 5, averaging 18 points on the season (16.6 across her last 5) — the 13+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -650 at Fanatics.

Aliyah Boston has cleared 6+ rebounds in 82% of her 38 games this season. She's hitting 80% over her last 10 and 60% over her last 5, averaging 7.9 rebounds on the season (6.8 across her last 5) — the 6+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -625 at Caesars.

Two legs from two different games at a combined -295 — each leg stands on its own record, and neither result can drag the other down.
